name: jbb-feature-dev
description: Complete feature development workflow: /elicit-requirements for requirements gathering, /research-problem for codebase research, /map-feature-to-plans and /break-down-initiative for feature splitting, /create-plan-tdd and /implement-plan-tdd for test-driven planning and execution (with stacked PR support via --scoping-doc), /code-review for multi-agent review, /validation-contract-generation for acceptance criteria traceability, /implement-change for current-session minimal implementation with independent built-in /simplify, specialist code review, local objective verification, and authorized submission through latest-head CI and explicit clean review, /commit and /submit-pr for PR lifecycle (Jira, monitoring, notifications, stacked PRs), /rebase-stack for cascade-rebasing stacked PR branches, /babysit-pr for watching a pull request to green unattended (polls CI, reads CI logs, fixes mechanical failures, escalates the rest; fixes by default with --no-fix for a read-only diagnosis, never merges, and never buys a green build with a weaker test suite), /sweep-followups for re-reading a session's transcript and filing follow-ups that were mentioned but never captured (watermarked, so a repeat sweep re-files nothing), /create-verification-skill and /maintain-verification-skill for project-persistent verification (the first interviews a repo and writes a local verify-<app> skill plus a feature map; the second is the upkeep pass that keeps that map honest, since a feature map without maintenance decays into a confident lie), /create-my-mode-skill for building a personal <handle>-mode skill from your own session transcripts. Ships a Stop hook that asks the model to file work it deferred without recording.
